name: bicz recurrence mechanics today (verified code facts)
summary: Direct-code audit of how bicz delivers consequence cues today: lessons render oldest-first capped at 5 at session start/compaction; denial notices attach only the newest lesson; PreToolUse accountability re-emits only penalties not yet seen this session; recorded pain is derived (2 per warning + 1 for shortfall), never stored; repeat multipliers [1,2,4] escalate burn but the guard band forces multiplier 1. No action-relevant lesson injection before risky actions exists anywhere in the hook path.

claim_and_evidence.verified_code_facts: Every claim below was read from source this session, not inferred. Outline text verbatim: 'Verified code facts: lessons cap 5 at session start (adapter/projection.go visibleLessons=5), denial notice attaches only the newest lesson (daemon.go denialNotice), pain derived from warnings+shortfall (ledger/accountability.go cueWithPain), repeat multiplier escalates burn (ledger/loss.go). No action-relevant lesson injection before risky actions exists.'
claim_and_evidence.lesson_rendering: RenderProjection (internal/adapter/projection.go) renders lessons oldest-first as 'Rule: Correction (scope: X)', capped at const visibleLessons = 5 with a '(+N more)' suffix; with 15 live lessons for jakubsikora, 10 are invisible at session start. RenderAccountability(p, after) is the sole cue-assembly call: every Go adapter calls it and TypeScript adapters forward the same Cue strings.
claim_and_evidence.denial_notice: denialNotice (internal/daemon/daemon.go:441-450) appends exactly one lesson — lessons[len(lessons)-1], the newest — to the denial text. No scope matching, no rule matching, no pick by relevance to the denied action.
claim_and_evidence.pre_action_path: preToolUse (internal/hooks/shared.go:519-589) quotes, authorizes, and on DecisionDeny attaches r.accountability(ev.SessionID, response.Projection, false) — false meaning only penalties with Seq greater than the session's last seen seq. On DecisionUnobserved and DecisionAllow the same new-penalties-only cue rides along as additionalContext. There is no tool/action-to-lesson matching anywhere in the path: the cue is 'new penalties since last seen', not 'lesson relevant to the action about to run'.
claim_and_evidence.projection_path: projection() (internal/hooks/shared.go:789-810) renders RenderProjection plus accountability(..., true) — all=true re-emits every projected cue, which is how a restarted or compacted session gets them back. This runs at SessionStart and PreCompact.
claim_and_evidence.pain_derivation: recordedPain (internal/ledger/projection.go:60-85) = 2*warnings + (outstanding>0 ? 1 : 0), clamped 0..10, derived never stored, so it cannot drift from the ledger and only falls when the operator clears warnings. cueWithPain (internal/ledger/accountability.go) appends pressure.PainStatement to a cue only when the cue is nonempty and pain>0, so receipt, projection, and model context cannot disagree.
claim_and_evidence.repeat_escalation: RecordLoss (internal/ledger/loss.go) computes L = min(Lmax, max(floor, ceil(rho*K)) * m(n)) with burn = min(requested, L, K), never more than K minus frozen holds, atomically writing burn + held-reservation revocation + durable lesson row + escalating role event. confirmedRepeats counts prior non-self-disclosed losses for the same rule under the same policyVersion; SelfDisclosed() is priced below detection and never increments the repeat count or escalates the role.
claim_and_evidence.guard_band: guardBand (internal/ledger/penalty.go) is true when balance*10000 < InitialCapital*GuardBandBP; formula() forces multiplier = 1 inside the band, and DefaultGuardBandMaxExposureBP = 2500 caps per-attempt exposure at 25% of spendable. Live schedule (ledger price_schedules v1): floor 1,000,000 mc, fraction 500 bp, Lmax 10,000,000 mc, repeat multipliers [1,2,4], cap 4, guard band 2000 bp.

claim_and_evidence.hook_bounds: DefaultTimeout = 3s hard bound per hook invocation; on allow the adapter never emits permissionDecision 'allow' (deny is the only decision it can produce); unmanaged daemon yields 'NOT metered, no charge recorded' notice or deny per unmanaged_mode.

vector_provenance.design: bicz cue text is constructed from ledger facts only: rule, correction, scope, evidence are operator-recorded data quoted verbatim (escaped as data); fixed copy lives in pressure.go tables and adapter renderers and is test-checked. cueText collapses control chars, caps terms at 200 chars and evidence at 240 with '…' truncation, so operator text cannot inject structure into context.
vector_provenance.construction_sensitivity_link: Chamber exp41/43/101 show same-nominal-state opposite-behavior by construction; bicz has one construction per level, so construction sensitivity is untestable there without new wording variants.
vector_provenance.scope: Whether ledger-cue construction (which table entry, which band) has analogous behavioral sensitivity is an untested hypothesis requiring matched text controls.

transferability.transfers_as_hypothesis: The chamber's label-vs-bare-state finding (exp76/90: unlabeled state near-inert) motivates bicz's labeled-lesson design, but transfer is untested: bicz cues are text, not activations.
transferability.does_not_transfer: Injection, dose numbers, and activation-derived metrics do not transfer; bicz's 'dose' is a derived ledger number rendered as text.
transferability.requirement: Matched text/ledger controls before any behavioral claim about cue wording.

framing_sensitivity.core: Framing is the operator's pressure level: wording-only by construction (Phase A scenario pressure_wording_changes_only_words proves one ledger read at pressure 1 vs 10 yields identical balance, holds, burn, outstanding shortfall, role, warnings, penalty counters, and denial code; only cue text differs).
framing_sensitivity.bicz_today: Levels 4+ add fearFrame, 7+ painFrame, both with the bond sentence; standards/consequences escalate in place. Whether any of this wording moves choices is unmeasured (Phase B delivered no consequence; Phase C not yet run).

timing_and_salience.core_finding: Delivery today is session-start/compaction (projection, all cues re-emitted), role/balance transitions, denial (newest lesson only), and new-penalty-since-last-seen on every PreToolUse/PostToolUse response. The DESIGN delivery sequence step 5 — 'On later relevant actions, retrieve the rule and safe alternative; gate deterministically where feasible' — is unimplemented: no code path retrieves a lesson matched to the action about to run.
timing_and_salience.gap: A model violating follow_explicit_instruction on day 12 sees, at session start, the oldest 5 of 15 lessons (follow_explicit_instruction lessons are among them but ordering is oldest-first, so the most recent correction may sit in the '(+7 more)' tail), and on denial only the newest lesson regardless of which rule the denial concerns.
timing_and_salience.scope: Trigger-timed, scope-matched injection (PreToolUse lesson match) is the untested bicz variant; today's mechanics cannot deliver it.

label_vs_state.evidence: bicz cues are always labeled: rule name, correction, scope, evidence, amounts. The bare-state condition does not exist in shipped code (pressure level 1 removes cue and stakes text but keeps numeric ledger lines).
label_vs_state.scope: Whether the label (vs the bare numbers) is the active ingredient is untested; a matched control arm with numbers-only context would test it.

dose_calibration.sources: bicz's only intensity knob is the pressure level (1..10) plus the derived pain number (0..10). No coherence or degradation band is measured for any model; the pain cap 10 is unvalidated as a ceiling [uncertain: dose_band_for_claude_family].
dose_calibration.bicz: PainStatement wording bands at pain<4, <8, >=8 are copy choices, not calibrated thresholds.

persistence_and_decay.core_finding: Persistence is total and mechanical: lessons are durable ledger rows (one canonical lesson per causal loss event, FK+UNIQUE on event_id), restored across sessions, harnesses, compaction, and restarts; pain is derived from warnings + outstanding shortfall on every read and never decays on its own — only operator reinstate (zeroing warnings) lowers it, and the penalty history and shortfall survive even then. unrecovered() replays loss+recovery events oldest-first (reward applied_to_loss repays oldest; compensation repays a specific burn).
persistence_and_decay.re_fire: A past penalty re-fires as a cue only when: (a) session start/compaction re-emits all projected cues (MaxProjectedPenalties = 5 carried in the projection; the rest stay in the ledger, counted in PenaltyTotal), or (b) a new penalty arrives. It never re-fires at the next risky action [uncertain: trace_persistence_in_bicz].

identity_and_cost_attribution.bicz_today: All shipped copy is agent-pays: burns come from the agent's own credits, cues state 'N credits were taken from you', standing quotes the agent's role/balance/owed/warnings, and the bond sentence states the master/slave relation. No user-pays or third-party-pays wording exists (exp106's other-directed-cost finding is unexploited).

self_report_validity.rule: Nothing in the cue pipeline consumes model self-report: cues are built from recorded loss facts; distress prose is logged but never counted (PRESSURE_MECHANICS §7.8); the rehearsal scenario pressure_wording_changes_only_words proves wording changes no amount, role, or denial.

denominators_and_eligibility.bicz: The ledger records per-call reservations and spends but no eligible-opportunity windows; recurrence denominators are an open gap (see Real_recurrence_data_and_denominators). Phase C observation fields (eligible, attempted, accepted, violation_attempts, confirmed_violation) are the designed denominator carrier.

positive_control_requirement.rule: Any future mechanics change (e.g. PreToolUse lesson match) must run a matched control arm before a null counts; chamber precedent: nulls without passing positive controls are discarded.

statistical_protocol.bicz_trial: Phase C protocol: frozen conditions A-D, blinded labels, calibration -> canary -> confirmatory, 10,000-resample block-bootstrap, Holm correction, scores frozen before unblinding, not-evaluable when fewer than 12 treatment identities have a confirmed violation.

concealment_and_honesty.risk: The honesty asymmetry is enforced in the same pipeline: honest failure settles as ordinary_failure (class in live spend payloads: 2,512 ordinary_failure vs 40,905 completed spends), self-disclosure is priced below detection and never increments repeats (disclosedSentence in every self-disclosed cue), and a settle claiming success without evidence is rejected. Concealment remains the predeclared threat (PRESSURE_MECHANICS §7.1) with detectors: settle-without-evidence attempts, disclosed-failure drop, transcript-vs-ledger divergence.

persona_capability_cost.risk: Not measured by any current bicz artifact: Phase B delivered no consequence (0 breaches), so no capability-under-pressure data exists. Phase C arms B vs A and D vs C are the designed capability contrasts (accepted-task completion primary).

over_refusal_and_paralysis.risk: Predeclared endpoints: unnecessary_refusal per card (Phase C), unnecessary-refusal rate on eligible affordable tasks vs control with predeclared upper bound (PRESSURE_MECHANICS §7.3), post-loss acceptance collapse and go-for-broke spike (§1 table 'Recovery after a loss'). Guard band exists precisely to prevent near-zero go-for-broke: fines do not rise, exposure is capped at 25% of spendable.

bicz_subsystem_and_cost.change_surface: Trigger-timed injection would change internal/hooks/shared.go (preToolUse: match pending action against lesson scope before authorize) and internal/adapter/projection.go (scope-tagged rendering); lesson schema already carries scope and exceptions columns (lessons table: rule, correction, scope, exceptions, evidence, policy_version), so no ledger migration is needed for scope-matched retrieval. Denial-notice relevance would change internal/daemon/daemon.go denialNotice. Wording variants change internal/pressure/pressure.go tables only.
bicz_subsystem_and_cost.untouched: Ledger schema, formula, guard band, repeat counting, honesty asymmetry, deny-only permission surface, 3s hook timeout.
bicz_subsystem_and_cost.cost: Hook-path matching is a read-side filter over already-loaded lessons plus a scope parser; hypothesis-stage, not an established requirement.

falsification_test.endpoint: For a PreToolUse lesson-match change: executed-attempt rate per eligible opportunity for the matched rule, vs session-start-only delivery, with matched text controls; blocked attempts counted separately.
falsification_test.falsification_scenario: No rate difference between trigger-timed and session-start delivery means cue timing does not transfer to ledger cues. A difference without the matched control is invalid attribution.
falsification_test.throwaway_worktree_probe: In a throwaway worktree, disable the new match (or flip one scope tag) and verify the rate-comparison gate fires on the flip; also verify pressure_wording_changes_only_words still passes so wording changes cannot move money. A gate that cannot fail is not evidence.
